title: 2003 SEMCOG annual precipitation
html:
2003 Annual precipitation

Station totals range from 24.17 inches at W-42 in northeastern Wayne County to 38.48 inches at A-05 in east-central Washtenaw County. Lower totals below 28 inches occur in parts of eastern Macomb, central Oakland, and northeastern/east-central Wayne Counties. Higher totals occur in southwest Livingston, central Washtenaw and southeast Oakland. The Table 1 station totals below preserve exact annual numbers.

The map covers Livingston, Oakland, Macomb, Washtenaw and Wayne Counties. Crosses locate rain gauges; asterisks mark roof-exposure gauges. Black contour lines connect equal values.

Annual precipitation totals from Table 1; amounts are inches. Monthly values and the four station-reliability columns remain in the source PDF.
